rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a person who controls or runs equipment or a system.

example.english: The operator of this machine has to be trained before starting work.
example.traditional: 呢部機嘅操作員要先受訓，先可以開工。
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 gei1 ge3 cou1 zok3 jyun4 jiu3 sin1 sau6 fan3 sin1 ho2 ji5 hoi1 gung1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the operator is the person driving a bus.

example.english: The bus operator saw someone running for the bus and waited for them.
example.traditional: 個巴士司機見到有人追車，特登等埋佢。
example.jyutping: go3 baa1 si2 si1 gei1 gin3 dou2 jau5 jan4 zeoi1 ce1 dak6 dang1 dang2 maai4 keoi5

rows.note: Use this for a telephone operator who connects or assists callers.

example.english: As soon as I got through, the operator asked which department I wanted.
example.traditional: 電話一打通，接線生就問我想搵邊個部門。
example.jyutping: din6 waa2 jat1 daa2 tung1 zip3 sin3 sang1 zau6 man6 ngo5 soeng2 wan2 bin1 go3 bou6 mun4
